in_hebrew.name: Row
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Form of Reuben, derived from 'see', 'behold'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Row הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew name Reuben, which means 'see', 'behold'. In the Bible, Reuben was the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah. The name Row can be seen as a form of Reuben, emphasizing the idea of seeing or beholding.
